MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 11

2. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 12

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 12
   C. 14
   D. 10

4. Solve for x: x + 5 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 5
   C. 17
   D. 13

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 36

6. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 1
   C. 12
   D. 7

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 18

8. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

9. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x > 5

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

12. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — 121
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 11² = 11 × 11
3. 11² = 121
Final Answer: 121
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. B — 32
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 4 × 8
3. Product = 32
Final Answer: 32
Mark reminder: method mark for multiplication; accuracy mark for answer

3. D — 10
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 6² + 8²
3. c² = 36 + 64
4. c² = 100

Final Answer: 10 cm
